test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If the volume of a right circular cone of height 11 cm is 297π cm³, find the diameter of its base.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of **cone** V = (1/3)πr²h

297π = (1/3) × π × r² × 11

r² = (297 × 3) ÷ 11 = 27 × 3 = 81

r = 9 cm → **Diameter** = 2 × 9 = 18 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 18 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Height** (h) of the cone = 11 cm

**Volume** (V) of the cone = 297π cm³

**Formula Used:**

Volume of **Right Circular Cone** = (1/3)πr²h

**Diameter** (d) = 2 × **Radius** (r)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1717f215cc9a219820e3610a3d51d38b519b3dca52310a724cb53801afbd07df.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (1/3) × π × r² × 11 = 297π

⇒ (1/3) × r² × 11 = 297

⇒ r² × 11 = 297 × 3

⇒ r² = 891 ÷ 11

⇒ r² = 81

⇒ r = √81 = 9 cm

⇒ **Diameter** = 2 × r = 2 × 9 = 18 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 18 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Slant Height of Cone

The slant height (l) is the distance from the apex to any point on the base circumference: l = √(r² + h²).

Surface Area of Cone

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = πrl and Total Surface Area (TSA) = πr(l + r).

Volume Relation with Cylinder

The volume of a **cone** is exactly one-third the volume of a **cylinder** with the same radius and height.</p
